d:
Kobra duniya ke sabse khatarnak sanpon men se ek hai. lekin bharat ke is ganv men in sanpon ke sath logon ka rishta kuchh alag hai. yahan kobra ki puja ki jati hai aur unhen insanon ke sath rahne ki jagah bhi milti hai. dekhie, is zahrile shikari ki zindgi ka ek anokha pahlu.
Bharat men SONY BBC Earth par Planet Earth III aur aise hi dilchasp sho dekhen.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
